policyFixed: The bands, the N0 normalization and the decision matrix are part of the shared review contract and expose no tunable thresholds; the mode is chosen on the status page.
policyModesNote: Both modes (ask / no-ask) use the same matrix; there is no extra risk cap, backend-specific gate or probability threshold.
argumentMax: Truncated characters of historical tool arguments
customRules: CUSTOM_RULES (global review guidance, at most 2000 characters)
breakerHelpTripped: Trips circuit breaker protection when {consecutive} blocking events (denials or aborted approvals) accumulate within 1 hour, or {windowDenials} within 30 minutes, pausing auto-approvals; reset on approval.
breakerHelpOff: Circuit breaker protection is disabled; recorded blocking events will not trip automated gating.
auditDescription: An audit write failure does not change the permission outcome. Log cleanup deletes only the SQLite audit, not the DSH session verdict records.
